SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM store_sales 
JOIN (SELECT * FROM time_dim WHERE t_hour = 8 AND t_minute >= 30) AS t 
    ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk 
JOIN (SELECT * FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_dep_count = 0) AS hd 
    ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk 
JOIN (SELECT * FROM store WHERE s_store_name = 'ese') AS s 
    ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk 
ORDER BY COUNT(*) 
LIMIT 100
